name: The Ancient Fish
source:
The Ancient Fish has been around since time immemorial, and thankfully thinks the land dwellers are fun amusement. The Ancient Fish visits them every once in a while to bestow wisdom and play sleepover party games. May or may not be a demi-god.

[From [url=https://banana-ooyu.itch.io/one-just-night]itch.io[/url]]
